answer: Rule: each identity must prove a distinct network origin, one autonomous system plus a latency fingerprint no other identity shares, checked every epoch. Fakes sharing a host show matching latency and the whole cluster loses its bond. Only then does the reward nectar flow, and the summit of honest origins sets the bar. Run the checks across a trellis of independent auditors. Attacker cost: one separate VPS per fake identity, about 5 dollars a month each, scaling linearly.
